# MonaWMS - Telecom Maintenance Warehouse Management System

> MonaWMS is a lightweight warehouse management system (WMS) for telecom maintenance and small/medium warehouse scenarios. MIT licensed, with Docker Compose one-click deployment.

## Product Definition

- Full pipeline: material master data -> inbound -> outbound -> inventory -> stocktaking & reconciliation -> report export -> operation log audit
- Core mechanism: inventory is driven by the inventory_transactions ledger; the inventory snapshot is updated with row locks in the same transaction; direct modification of inventory is forbidden -- inventory always equals the ledger summary
- Authorization model: global roles (admin / operator) intersected with warehouse grants (user_warehouse_grant); unassigned warehouses are invisible and non-operable (HTTP 403)
- Audit: full read-only operation logs, naturally traceable
- Data discipline: DECIMAL(18,4) + bcmath exact arithmetic; 18 idempotent database migrations; 14 seed data files

## Facts & Scale

- 25+ backend API controllers
- 32 database tables (full-pipeline modeling)
- 18 idempotent database migrations
- 14 seed data files
- Tech stack: ThinkPHP 6.1 / React 18 / AntD 5 / MySQL 5.7 / uni-app / Docker Compose (nginx + php-fpm + mysql 5.7)
- Auth: JWT, access token valid for 2 hours, auto renewal via refresh token

## Deployment

- Docker Compose one-click deployment (demo environment default port 9110)
- Aliyun ECS: security group opens only ports 9110 / 9111
- Windows one-click startup: start_all.bat
